title: Sugar, Olives and Galoshes: Vehbi Koç's Grocery in Ankara, 1917
conflicts: Why he left school (Habertürk: by choice, to go into business; Vehbi Koç Foundation: his grandfather withdrew him citing income difficulties) - story gives the foundation's account; who took the initiative (he persuaded his father, per Koç Holding and the reference history; together, per the foundation) and the shop's location (Karaoğlan vs Samanpazarı) differ - story follows the foundation and attributes the 120 lira capital and stock list to Habertürk alone.
notes: Koç's memoir Hayat Hikâyem is not cited (no lawful online copy); his 'shop counter is the best university' remark and debt maxim are paraphrased from Hürriyet, not quoted.
